test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Rupak visits his mother __on a regular basis.__
solution:
The correct answer is '**regularly**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for a given group of words is '**regularly**'.
 
• **Regularly** - at fixed intervals or times; frequently.
 
 
• *Example: The doctor advised him to take his medicine **regularly**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *regularly.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **weekly** - once a week; every week.
 
• **daily** - every day; daily.
 
• **everyday** - common, ordinary, or normal; happening or used every day.
